field.label: Minimum TTL
field.help: Answers with a shorter TTL than this are still kept for this long. Use 0s to honour the upstream TTL.

field.label: Maximum TTL
field.help: Answers are never kept longer than this. Use 0s for no cap, or -1s to disable caching entirely.

field.label: Negative TTL
field.help: How long a failed lookup is remembered. Use -1s to disable negative caching.

field.label: Maximum Entries
field.help: Upper bound on the number of cached answers. Use 0 for unlimited.

field.label: Enable Prefetching
field.help: Refresh frequently queried names before they expire, so that common lookups are always answered from cache.

field.label: Threshold
field.help: How many times a name must be queried within the tracking window before it is prefetched.

field.label: Tracking Window
field.help: How long a name is tracked for the threshold above.

field.label: Maximum Tracked Names
field.help: Upper bound on the number of tracked names. Use 0 for unlimited.
